faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MACT Baghpat Assistant Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Assistant Accountant post is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Accountant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired government servants with knowledge of the UP Treasury Portal and accounts work. A notarized affidavit confirming no pending criminal cases is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Accountant position is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Assistant Accountant post?
faq.answer: The salary will be the last drawn pay minus the net pension, on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Accountant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Accountant post in MACT Baghpat.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Accountant role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, Interview, and merit based on ACRs and suitability.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What specific computer knowledge is required for the Assistant Accountant position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have computer knowledge in the UP Treasury Portal and be proficient in accounts work, including salary bill preparation.

faq.question: Q10. Does the notification mention any preference for candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates with court accounts experience.
